usage.guide: Make a plain GET to https://btcnode.uk/api/info with no body or query params; pay the x402 quote (~$0.001 USDC, exact scheme on Base/eip155:8453). The response is a flat JSON object with live full-node status: body.chain (e.g. "main"), body.blocks (current block height), body.difficulty (string), body.connections (peer count), and body.success (true). It is a synchronous call — read the result directly from the response body.
